title: Northbeam TechWorks Credit Control: Relief Recognised Against Counter Charges
content:
The relief recognised against the charges a desk settlement covers on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job is read from the grounds the write-offs standing on the job were granted on.

**Where a write-off granted on the membership ground stands on the job**, every write-off standing on the job is recognised against them.

**Where the only write-offs standing on the job were granted as goodwill**, those goodwill write-offs are recognised against them.

**Where neither situation holds**, no relief is recognised.

## The grounds, read side by side

| Write-offs standing on the job | Relief recognised |
| --- | --- |
| at least one on the membership ground | every write-off standing on the job, whatever ground each rests on |
| all of them as goodwill, none on the membership ground | those goodwill write-offs |
| some on other grounds, none on the membership ground and not all as goodwill | nothing |
| none at all | nothing |

The second reading is a strict one: the goodwill write-offs are recognised only where they are the whole of what stands on the job. A goodwill write-off standing beside a write-off on the retailer's own error, with none on the membership ground, falls into the third line and nothing is recognised.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job on file.*

**Goodwill alone.** A hypothetical job carries 28.00 USD written off as goodwill and nothing else. The second reading governs, and 28.00 USD is recognised.

**Goodwill beside a write-off on the retailer's own error.** The same job also carries 31.20 USD written off on the retailer's own error, with nothing on the membership ground. The third reading governs: nothing is recognised.

**A membership write-off standing too.** The job carries 84.60 USD written off on the membership ground alongside the 28.00 USD of goodwill. The first reading governs, and 112.60 USD is recognised.
